a.description: (Batch of) `float`-like matrix-shaped `Tensor`(s) which are to be pseudo-inverted.

tol.description: Threshold below which the singular value is counted as 'zero'. Default value: `None` (i.e., `eps * max(rows, cols) * max(singular_val)`).
constraints: tol must be one of zero

validate_args.description: When `True`, additional assertions might be embedded in the graph. Default value: `False` (i.e., no graph assertions are added).
constraints: validate_args must be one of True, False

output.description: (Batch of) `int32` scalars representing the number of non-zero singular values.
